summary: Iteration 7 Payment System testing completed successfully. All 20 backend tests passed 100%. Frontend PaymentFlow component verified working across all entry points (GlobalVision unlock, Deposit modal). Major features: 1) Backend /api/payment/addresses returns 5 chains with REAL wallet addresses, 2) /api/payment/verify returns verified:false for test wallets (expected since no real payment), 3) /api/payment/manual-confirm records payments for review, 4) PaymentFlow UI opens from GlobalVision (9.9 USDT) and Deposit modal, 5) All 5 chains present (TRC20, ERC20, BSC, ARB, SOL), 6) Correct addresses displayed per chain, 7) 3-step flow (Select Chain → Show Address → Verify), 8) Auto-verify + manual TX hash fallback present, 9) Copy address works. VIP Upgrade PaymentFlow not tested because demo user is already VIP ($109.90 balance). All previous features still working including i18n EN/CN.
